T1.name: T1 SETTLE+1
T1.what_it_does: every DAILY_LASTDAY lump moves from the instance last day to last day + 1; mass past day 33 renormalised over 1..33

drop_past_33.note: TV is scale-free so it equals renorm; only the level (MAPE) differs; sum of sim days then < window total

T2.name: T2 COLLECT (all non-always-on)
T2.what_it_does: every non-always-on component convolved with the attendance kernel P(collect on s+k) = p_(s+k) PROD_(j<k)(1-p_(s+j)); truncated at day 33 and renormalised

symmetric_smoothing_control.note: centred box on every non-always-on component (same scope as T2 all); a model-free smoother that also moves mass EARLIER, which a payout cannot do. If it matches T2, the TV gain is de-lumping a population average, not a collection lag; the T1+box vs T1+T2 rows ask the same question after the rank lumps have been moved to their settle day.

T2b.name: T2b COLLECT (rank lumps only)
T2b.what_it_does: the same kernel applied ONLY to DAILY_LASTDAY lumps; milestone / accrual / p_day-placed mass is collected same-day by construction

T3.name: T3 LEADERBOARD CURVES
T3.what_it_does: for DAILY_LASTDAY categories with a data_event_accrual curve, a MILESTONE share s of each instance is placed along the marginal of cum_token_share (settle 0, collected same-day under T2b) and 1-s stays the end lump; s swept per category - an EMPIRICAL CALIBRATION, not the model (the model needs packRungs_/rewardE_ ladder pricing per resource)

sweep_alone.label: T3 alone (no settle, no collect): s only changes PLACEMENT

curvelen_variant.note: place along the curve over its OWN length (instance_length_days) starting on the grid day, so a 1-day grid instance with a 2-day curve pays ~93% on day d and ~7% on d+1, and its lump moves to d+1 - this is the mechanism behind T1 for these events (a 1-day event that starts mid-day ends on the next calendar date)

sweep_under_T1_T2b.label: T3 under T1 + T2b(lumps only) + T5: s decides which share is paid same-day (milestone) vs settled +1 and collected (rank)

T4.name: T4 SEASON PASS
T4.what_it_does: Season Pass (Free)/(Paid) mass placed on tier-crossing days instead of p_day over the lane; per resource the tier masses are the base SP track rewards of that resource (equal per tier when the track pays none of it); each cal_curr pass instance is its own season
T4.route: spPackTiers_ IS callable offline but returns 0 entries on this dump (no envelope authored on the SP ladder; it also places tiers linearly in days, not by points). Used instead: cumulative p_day as the SPT proxy - window SPT total from sptTotals_(seg,payer,ctx).meas (includes the D18 synthetic Core anchor) accrued prop p_day, tier i on the first day the running total reaches SP.cum[i]. The engine-linear rule, a continuous-accrual (_spread) form and the ACTUAL SPT total (_actualspt, data_econ_daily sum) are reported as alternatives.

T5.name: T5 FLAT->p_day
T5.what_it_does: categories with no cal_curr instance (Ads, Other, IAPs, FlowerCoop, River Rush, Rainbow Maker where present) spread prop p_day instead of 1/33

as_specified.label: ALL TOGGLES ON, as specified (T4 at its least-bad variant)

t3_sweep.label: T3 under T1 + best T2 + best T4 + T5

T6.what_it_does: the ACTUAL series shifted by k days (k=+1: actual moved one day LATER, i.e. a[d] <- a[d-1]; k=-1: earlier), sim untouched, window-truncated; TV against the baseline sim, the T1-only sim and the best-combination sim
T6.weekday_weekend_rates_note: data_seg_beh weekday vs weekend rates in this dump differ by < 0.03, so always-on sources carry almost no day-of-week signal; the day-axis test rests on the event lumps
